create_instruction_dict: create an InstructionDict from word counts, instruction counts, and a corrections mapping
parse_instruction_to_tokens: parse a natural language instruction into token indices with optional padding
deparse_tokens_to_instruction: deparse a tensor of token indices back into natural language sentences
clean_and_correct_instruction: clean and correct an instruction string using punctuation removal and word corrections
get_word_or_inst_index: get the vocabulary index for a word or the index for a full instruction
